scripts.dev: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,cyan "pnpm --filter @xingtu/server dev" "pnpm --filter @xingtu/client dev"
scripts.db:init: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server build && pnpm --filter @xingtu/client build
scripts.verify:operations: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-collector-hardening.ts && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-operations-business.ts && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-operations-api.ts && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-operations-race.ts && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-operations-regression.ts && node scripts/verify-backup.mjs
scripts.verify:docker-fixes: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-alert-rule-state.ts && pnpm --filter @xingtu/server exec tsx scripts/verify-run-recovery.ts
